content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm looking for the procedure to update the firmware of a [product_name] (without display). I inserted an SD card with the .bin files but nothing happened. Could someone assist me? I've checked the documentation but couldn't find details. Thanks in advance, [user_name]
There’s no difference in firmware update procedures between models with display and those without. Could you clarify what you mean by the update not working?

Hello, I followed instructions online and on the [company_name] website. I downloaded the bin files, verified the checksum (SHA-256, valid), formatted the SD card to FAT32, copied the files to the SD root, powered down the device, inserted the SD, and powered it up. The module without a display offers no indication that the update is happening or completed. The firmware version did not change for this device ([article_no], [version_no], firmware V1.08.02, IP XXX.XXX.XXX.XXX, status running, SD card 32GB, formatted FAT32). I’m out of ideas.
With your [product_name], it’s not possible to perform a firmware upgrade. Models with firmware V1.08.xx cannot be updated.

Thank you, I didn’t notice that. Has anyone found a manual upgrade method? Or is it impossible? Should I purchase a new model, or is exchange possible? What options are available? Also, is there a section for feature requests? I’d appreciate a function to identify which expansion modules are connected to the CPU. Thanks in advance
If I plan to buy a new module for updated features, how can I tell if it’s the latest version or an older one? Is there a date code or specific identifier? Thanks.

You can identify the updated [product_name] by its order number as [company_name] changed the numbering system. The current models' order numbers end with [article_no]. You’ll also need the latest software [product_name] [version_no]. You can download a free update to the software under this link: [document]. If you’re using Windows, run the setup as administrator.
Hi, you can find the order number, firmware version, and required software version directly on the packaging, so you don’t need to open it to confirm if it’s the newest model.
Thank you all for your help. [user_name]
A new question from [user_name] has been moved to its own thread titled 'When ordering the new version, do old expansion modules still work?'. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue discussed is difficulty updating the firmware of a [product_name] without a display, as the standard SD card method gives no clear feedback on the update process for such models. It emerged that devices with certain firmware versions ([version_no] V1.08.xx) cannot be updated, which is not clearly communicated before or during attempts, leading to user frustration and wasted effort.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect direct feedback when performing firmware updates, clear information about compatibility, and the ability to easily identify the version and features of a device before purchase.
